title: Factoring a Row from the Stream
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{row}(n,i)$ be a family of Boolean words indexed by time $n$ and coordinate $i<l$, and let $N,j$ be natural numbers with $j<N$. For every Boolean word $u$, there is a Boolean word $v$ such that the stream of the first $N$ rows followed by $u$ equals the stream of the first $j$ rows, followed by the packed encoding of row $j$, followed by $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{row}$ assigns a Boolean word to each time and each coordinate $i<l$
replaced: For every row family, bound $N$, time $j < N$, and trailer, there is a remainder word such that the full stream of $N$ rows plus trailer equals the stream of the first $j$ rows, followed by the packed encoding of row $j$, followed by that remainder; obtaining the row itself still requires the native loader.
